title: OpenSCAD to Web API Parameter Mapping
description: Machine-readable mapping between OpenSCAD customizer variables and web API parameters. Source of truth for cross-platform validation.

ui_parameter_format.description: OpenSCAD Customizer dropdown format guidelines to prevent duplicate options
guidelines: Use human-readable labels directly as values (e.g., 'Rounded' not 'rounded:Rounded')
The default value must exactly match one of the dropdown options
Avoid value:Label format as it can cause duplicate entries in some OpenSCAD versions
For test system compatibility, normalize both UI labels and lowercase values in calculated section
ui_parameter_format.test_system_note: Test system passes parameters via -D flags with lowercase values (e.g., 'rounded', 'positive'). The OpenSCAD file normalizes these to work with UI labels.

parameters.description: First line of braille text (Unicode braille characters)

parameters.note: The Customizer cannot add fields on demand, so the two lines that reach the grid_rows maximum of 10 sit in their own tab instead of lengthening the main text input. The web app grows its line list dynamically and has no equivalent split.

parameters.description: Show TEXT TOO LONG warning and clip rows to the cell capacity. Off = render every pasted character (rows may crowd the seam).
parameters.note: OpenSCAD-only toggle; the web app validates cell counts before generation instead

parameters.description: Visual = recessed triangle (plus optional letter square) in marker cells at the start of each row. Tactile = raised arrow on the embossing plate and matching recess on the counter plate, centred in the seam gap, with no marker cells.
parameters.note: Ported to the web app 2026-07-29; enum casing differs on the wire (visual/tactile). Schema home: indicators.indicator_mode

parameters.description: Tactile indicator width measured around the cylinder (mm)
parameters.note: Tactile indicator mode; same name on the web app, defaults asserted equal there

parameters.description: Tactile indicator length measured along the cylinder axis (mm); long enough for a fingertip to read the direction of the point in one pass
parameters.note: Tactile indicator mode; same name on the web app, defaults asserted equal there. Aligned to the web value 2026-08-18 (was 5.0)

parameters.description: How far the embossing plate's arrow stands proud of the surface (mm); kept below the braille dot height so the dots carry the rolling pressure
parameters.note: Tactile indicator mode; same name on the web app, defaults asserted equal there. Aligned to the web value 2026-08-18 (was 0.8)

parameters.description: Outline margin added around the counter plate's recess (mm) so the arrow enters even when slightly misaligned
parameters.note: Tactile indicator mode; same name on the web app, defaults asserted equal there

parameters.description: Counter recess depth added on top of the arrow raise (mm); 0 gives exact same-depth nesting
parameters.note: Tactile indicator mode; same name on the web app, defaults asserted equal there

parameters.description: Preset that controls multiple parameters (spacing, dot dimensions, cylinder settings)
parameters.note: Web UI label is 'Card Thickness' but this is NOT the removed card-geometry feature—it's a parametric memory system

parameters.description: Braille dot shape for both emboss and counter plates
Visual indicator mode only: adds the square letter marker next to the always-present alignment triangle. Ignored when indicator_mode is Tactile.
Polygonal cutout circumscribed radius (0 = no cutout)
Number of sides/points for polygonal cutout
Seam offset (degrees) — Rotates starting position around cylinder

Text capacity in braille cells per row (matches the web app default of 13 text cells). Visual indicator mode adds 2 marker cells when Indicator Letters are On, or 1 (the alignment triangle) when Off; Tactile mode adds none. Up to 14 text cells fit the default cylinder in either of the narrower layouts.
Spacing between dots within a cell
Base diameter of rounded dot frustum
Diameter of rounded dome (linked to cone flat top)

validation_rules.description: Rules for validating parameter consistency between OpenSCAD and web API

checks.name: all_openscad_params_mapped
checks.description: Every OpenSCAD customizer parameter must have a web API equivalent

checks.name: default_values_match
checks.description: Default values must be identical across platforms

checks.name: dropdown_no_duplicates
checks.description: OpenSCAD dropdown options should not cause duplicate entries in Customizer
checks.check_method: Verify UI default matches exactly one dropdown option

checks.name: ranges_match
checks.description: Value ranges must be identical (where applicable)

checks.name: sections_align
checks.description: Parameter sections/groupings should match UI organization

checks.name: types_compatible
checks.description: Data types must be compatible (string, float, integer, enum)

notes: Version 2.0.0: Card support removed, cylinder-only operation
Version 2.1.0: Paper thickness preset system added, defaults updated to match web app 0.4mm preset

Version 2.2.0: Aggressive customizer polish (file rename, preset routing extraction, magic-number naming, $fn policy doc), TEXT TOO LONG warning geometry, expanded test coverage (presets/backward-compat/text-too-long suites, 3 new cross-platform fixtures, slider-range schema validator), split-repo cleanup (Plug Puller + CAD-to-OpenSCAD methodology extracted to sibling repos)

Version 2.5.0: Cross-repo parity audit (Phase 08). The only two numeric drifts in the 46-parameter surface were aligned to the web app: tactile_indicator_length 5.0 -> 10.0 mm and tactile_indicator_raise 0.8 -> 0.5 mm. The MakerWorld variant still carries the old pair until its own re-flatten phase

Version 2.4.0: Line_5 - Line_10 added so the Customizer exposes every row grid_rows allows; Line_9 and Line_10 sit in the 'More Braille Lines (Advanced)' section because the Customizer cannot add fields on demand
This mapping is the source of truth for cross-platform validation
Human-readable documentation in docs/PARAMETER_MAPPING.md should be kept in sync
Web API uses snake_case; OpenSCAD uses snake_case (aligned)
UI dropdown labels are human-friendly (e.g., 'Rounded' not 'rounded')
OpenSCAD normalizes both formats in calculated values section
Paper thickness preset controls 23 parameters across spacing, dot dimensions, and cylinder settings
Web UI label 'Card Thickness' is NOT card geometry—it's a parametric memory system for known-good values
Rendering quality parameters affect mesh resolution, not actual geometry dimensions
